dic_postprocess.analysisRun.makeStrainOverlay

Postprocess ops helper. Expected caller: labkit_DICPostprocess_app.

Syntax

function overlay = makeStrainOverlay(referenceImage, strainMap, mask, roiMask, opts)

Description

Inputs are reference image, strain map, display mask, ROI mask, and overlay options. Output is the rendered overlay image. Side effects: none.
